selection.algorithm: Sort complete eligible external symbols ascending by SHA256(seed + newline + symbol), symbol as tie breaker; take first min(40,N).
selection.exclude: all 141 database-universe identifiers (140 traded symbols plus BTC context), and any exact external symbol found in the source traded inventory
selection.eligibility: Trading LinearPerpetual; quote and settle USDT; not prelisting; launchTime <= raw warmup start; OHLCV,mark,premium endpoint start/end probes contain all requested 5 completed aligned minutes; funding endpoint has history. No price-return or outcome calculations during eligibility. Full post-selection integrity failures cannot trigger replacements.

candidate_population: All eligible V2 from frozen A.v2 with last completed minute mark close and 1440-minute turnover, quote/state gates ignored exactly as frozen adapter; all V3 A.structural prequote (side, frozen trend permission, completed structural reclaim/rejection before geometry). Only complete contiguous literal 200 x 15m history; no execution, geometry, stop or target calls in validation.
entry: ceil(decisionAt/60000)*60000 OPEN; endpoint OPEN entry+h*60000; all h+1 minute timestamps must exist.
return_bps: -originalSideSign * (endOpen/entryOpen - 1) * 10000; BUY originalSideSign +1, SELL -1; inversion algebraic diagnostic only

feature_formulas.reactionType: Frozen A.structural qualifying nearest level reaction.state; active, matching side, knownAt <= closedBarOpenAt, completed reclaim/rejection; exact sort distancePct,knownAt,id.
feature_formulas.premiumZ: Official premium 1m close v; z=(v-mean(previous1440 observations))/sample_std(previous1440 observations), ddof=1, min360; latest bar timestamp+60000 <= decision; max staleness120000ms; excludes current observation from baseline; prior row-count rolling semantics preserved, gaps never fabricated.
feature_formulas.relativeStrength60: Symbol last completed1m close C(cut-60000)/C(cut-3660000)-1 minus BTC equivalent, cut=floor(decision/60000)*60000; exact endpoint timestamps.
feature_formulas.utcHour: UTC hour of decisionAt exactly22, entire hour; no optimized narrower windows

historical_receipt_limit: Historical source event labels plus frozen lags only; original publication/receipt unknown. Historical reconstruction is not certified live causality.
missing: No feature fill, interpolation, quantile recomputation or future backfill. Missing feature excludes that hypothesis only; missing minute path excludes that horizon only; malformed/conflicting bars rejected and counted; 200-bar fresh continuous warmup after gaps.
episodes: Frozen baseline surfaces: per-symbol side (or WATCH) state updated on each eligible comparison scan, continuation <=30m since lastSeenAt; ID SHA256 JSON [symbol,sideKey,firstBirthAt] first24hex; hypothesis episode namespace engine:symbol:candidateSide:underlyingEpisodeId. V2 retains V3-side underlying episode lineage as discovery did.
weights: Primary all qualifying candidates equal; companions mean of symbol means, UTC calendar-month means, episode means; first qualifying candidate/episode sensitivity (never substitute a later complete endpoint).
chronological_halves: Fixed midpoint of decision window, not candidate-count split; prospective locked calendar midpoint.

inference.method: Resample cluster sufficient-statistic (sum,count) pairs with replacement; percentile 95% two-sided CI and 99% one-sided lower bound. Worst lower bound across symbol/month/week/episode used. Report overlap; independent one-way cluster schemes are sensitivity checks, not formal two-way cluster guarantees.
inference.multiplicity: Exactly five directional composite hypotheses; Bonferroni alpha .05/5=.01. Each composite is intersection-union across four horizons: all four must pass at alpha .01; no horizon selection. Both streams separately labeled; no selecting success from one stream as joint confirmation.

classification_rules.adequacy: Every horizon >=1000 candidates,500 episodes,30 symbols,4 months,12 weeks external; both halves >=250 candidates; no symbol >20%; each applicable side >=100 candidates,50 episodes,10symbols. Prospective months/weeks requirements replaced by locked60days.
classification_rules.pass: Adequate; all4 worst99% one-sided cluster lower bounds >0; all4 candidate,symbol,month,episode means >0; both halves and applicable BUY/SELL means >0; leave-best-symbol/month/episode/week means >0 at all4 horizons; H4 weekday and session checks pass. Label VALIDATES EXPLORATORY SIGNAL.
classification_rules.fail: Adequate but at least one co-primary candidate mean <=0 or one required weighting/half/side/leave-best sign <=0 or H4 calendar check fails. Label WEAKENS / FAILS VALIDATION.
classification_rules.inconclusive: Any required adequacy missing, unavailable source definition, or all required signs positive but corrected confidence criterion not met. Label INCONCLUSIVE. No retesting alternate bins,horizons,delays or thresholds.

utc22_checks: Preserve all UTC22 decisions. Tabulate each weekday/month, US DST state, US federal-holiday flags, proximity to each symbol actual settled funding (within120m of latest known event), Asia UTC midnight in upcoming2h and US20:00/21:00 UTC equity close in preceding2h. No causal attribution. Require >=5/7 positive weekday means; all weekdays with >=100 candidates nonnegative; >=2/3 positive months; supported DST and funding-proximity groups each positive; leave-best-calendar-day and week positive at all4 horizons. Calendar strata descriptive, no optimized timing or new hypotheses.

prospective.start_rule: first UTC midnight >=48h after BOTH preregistration timestamp and research-only capture readiness receipt; readiness requires full24h dry-run with outcome seal,100% candidate accounting and required feature semantics. Activation timestamp must be recorded before any cohort outcomes. No existing or pre-registration data qualifies.
prospective.extension_rule: Exactly one extension at day60 based only on sealed counts/coverage if any hypothesis insufficient; whole cohort extends, zero outcome access. Day120 classify incomplete hypotheses inconclusive.
prospective.eligibility: Fixed discovery140 membership intersect currently Trading LinearPerpetual USDT from preregistration metadata snapshot; never add new symbols; later delisting removes future surfaces, retains records.

economic: Statistical zero threshold separated from practical materiality. Report gross bps vs frozen V2 7.5bps maker/taker roundtrip fees and V3 11bps taker/taker fees; execution-specific slippage, spreads, rounding, funding and capacity additional; no universal cost cutoff or net profitability claim.
draft_departures: User explicitly requests candidate-weighted primary and all4 horizons, overriding draft first-episode30m primary. Draft incremental matched-control primary omitted because current authorization freezes only five absolute directional hypotheses; no added controls/features/mining. Locked60+single60days replaces draft180+180 for frequency/coverage practicality; no arbitrary early stopping.
